commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) is coming onto the pitch as Emanuel Emegha cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90+2' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Metz out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
90+1' Kevin N'Doram (Metz) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
90+1' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Kevin N'Doram (Metz), whose header flies narrowly wide of the right post.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' A clumsy foul by Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) and Clement Turpin blows his whistle.
86' Substitution. Benjamin Tetteh (Metz) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Koffi Kouao walks off.
84' Patrick Vieira has decided to make a change. Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg) replaces Angelo.
83' 0 - 1 Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
83' A cross from Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
80' Malick Mbaye (Metz) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
78' That will be all from Joel Asoro who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz).
78' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) trips an opposition player and Clement Turpin signals a foul.
77' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
75' Angelo (Strasbourg) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
72' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though.
71' Matthieu Udol (Metz) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Matz Sels.
70' Malick Mbaye (Metz) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
69' Gerzino Nyamsi (Strasbourg) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
68' Patrick Vieira prepares a substitution. Jessy Deminguet is replaced by Lebo Mothiba (Strasbourg).
68' The referee signals a substitution. Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) is brought on as a substitute for Dilane Bakwa.
67' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
65' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
64' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
63' We are about to witness a subsitution. Malick Mbaye (Metz) for Cheikh Sabaly.
63' Laszlo Boloni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Simon Elisor (Metz) replacing Oscar Estupinan.
63' Substitution. Arthur Atta (Metz) replaces Lamine Camara.
62' Fali Cande (Metz) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
62' Metz have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
61' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Clement Turpin stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
58' Jessy Deminguet (Strasbourg) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
57' Jessy Deminguet (Strasbourg) picks up an injury.
54' Koffi Kouao (Metz) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
53' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) latches onto a cross into the box from the wing and gets in a header. It went well towards the goal, but it was blocked by one of the defenders.
51' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
51' Clement Turpin blows his whistle after Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
51' Strasbourg enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Clement Turpin has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Clement Turpin signals.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Christophe Herelle (Metz) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
43' Looks like Christophe Herelle (Metz) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
43' Clement Turpin couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) and blew his whistle.
41' Koffi Kouao (Metz) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
41' Poor challenge! Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) is penalised for tripping and Clement Turpin blows his whistle.
40' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well over the bar.
40' The Metz players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
39' Oscar Estupinan (Metz) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the left post.
36' Oscar Estupinan (Metz) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.

34' Oscar Estupinan (Metz) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Clement Turpin blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
34' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
33' Rough tackle by Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
31' A pass by Christophe Herelle (Metz) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
29' Kevin N'Doram (Metz) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.
28' An attempted cross from Joel Asoro (Metz) is cleared.
26' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Danley Jean Jacques (Metz), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
24' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
22' Koffi Kouao (Metz) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
20' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) commits a foul and Clement Turpin immediately signals a free kick.
17' A cross into the box from Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) is cleared.
17' A pass by Fali Cande (Metz) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
15' Koffi Kouao (Metz) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Fali Cande (Metz) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
12' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) was too forceful with his tackle and Clement Turpin interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
11' Alexandre Oukidja leaps to intercept the corner kick from Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg).
10' Angelo (Strasbourg) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
8' The free kick is taken by Angelo (Strasbourg), but ball is cleared.
8' Matthieu Udol (Metz) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
6' PENALTY APPEAL by Strasbourg, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
5' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Metz.
5' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Matthieu Udol (Metz). Clement Turpin saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
2' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
